how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal at dsssbonline.nic.in.
Read Advertisement No. 06/2026 and confirm the applicable post-code eligibility.
If you have previously registered on the DSSSB OARS portal, log in using your existing registration details.
New candidates should select Click for New Registration.
Enter the required personal information and Class 10 examination details.
Provide an active email ID and mobile number.
Complete the required verification and registration steps.
Log in with the generated registration number and password.
Open Advertisement No. 06/2026 and choose the relevant post code.
Enter educational qualifications, experience and other required eligibility information.
Enter reservation, category and age-relaxation information where applicable.
Upload any documents requested during the application stage.
Review the application form carefully before submission.
Pay the prescribed Rs. 100 fee through SBI e-pay, if not exempt.
Complete final submission before 11 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

Important: Once an online application has been finally submitted, DSSSB does not permit changes or corrections, including changes to the candidate's category. Applicants should verify every detail before final submission.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: DSSSB has released for the Combined Examinations 2026 covering Junior Engineer (Electric/Electrical), Multi-Tasking Staff, MTS Aaya (Female) and MTS General Duty posts. The official 32-page PDF includes department-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, essential experience, age limits, salary, application fee, examination patterns, qualifying marks, reservation provisions, online registration instructions and other important recruitment conditions. content_sections.heading: DSSSB Vacancy 2026 - 1260 Posts
content_sections.text: The notification announces 1,260 vacancies under two post codes . Post Code 809/26 covers Junior Engineer (Electric/Electrical), while Post Code 810/26 covers Multi-Tasking Staff, including General Duty and Aaya (Female) posts. Highest JE Vacancies: Delhi Transco Limited has 75 Junior Engineer Electrical vacancies, followed by NDMC with 67 and MCD with 26. These posts have different age limits, essential qualifications and experience conditions. Important: The 239 MTS Aaya vacancies are specifically designated for female candidates. The Directorate of Education accounts for 996 MTS vacancies, comprising 757 General Duty and 239 Aaya positions. DSSSB JE Syllabus 2026

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The essential educational qualification differs between Junior Engineer and MTS posts. Candidates must meet the requirements of the department for which they seek consideration by 11 December 2026 . Yes. Eligible candidates with an Electrical Engineering degree can apply for the NDMC, MCD and Delhi Transco Limited vacancies without mandatory previous experience, subject to each department's qualification and age conditions. However, the Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board and DUSIB specify a diploma-based qualification route. Applicants should not assume that every engineering qualification is accepted for every department without checking the applicable Recruitment Rules. Yes. Electrical Engineering diploma holders can apply, but experience requirements differ by department. NDMC: Two years of professional Electrical Engineering experience required for diploma holders. Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board: Two years of electrical installation or maintenance experience required. MCD: Two years of professional experience as Electrical Engineer after completing the qualifying diploma. Delhi Transco Limited: No essential experience required. DUSIB: No essential experience required. Yes. Class 10 or Matriculation pass candidates can apply for the notified MTS positions, subject to the age and other eligibility conditions. No previous work experience is prescribed as an essential requirement for the notified MTS vacancies. The Directorate of Education has advertised 239 MTS Aaya (Female) vacancies . Eligible female candidates with a recognized Class 10/Matriculation qualification and the prescribed age can apply.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The ordinary age limit is 18 to 27 years for most vacancies. The NDMC Junior Engineer (Electric) post has an age limit of 18 to 32 years . Age eligibility is determined as on 11 December 2026. Important: OBC reservation and age relaxation are available only to candidates meeting DSSSB's notified OBC (Delhi) requirements. OBC candidates from outside Delhi are generally considered under the unreserved category for these benefits. For specified NDMC, MCD, DUSIB and Directorate of Education positions, eligible contractual employees of the same department may receive one-time upper-age relaxation up to the actual period of contractual service, subject to a maximum of five years and the prescribed requirement of at least 180 working days in the relevant year. This concession does not automatically apply to every applicant or department.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: DSSSB will conduct separate combined examinations for Junior Engineer and MTS under their respective post codes. The recruitment also involves online e-dossier submission, document verification and department/post allocation based on merit, eligibility, reservation and preferences. Skill, endurance, driving or trade tests may be conducted where required by the job.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Junior Engineer Electrical Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Junior Engineer candidates will appear in a Two-Tier Technical Examination . Tier-I is used for shortlisting, while Tier-II marks determine the final examination merit. Tier-I Qualification: Minimum qualifying marks apply separately to Section B (Domain Subject) and to the combined marks of Sections A and B. There is no separate minimum qualifying requirement for Section A alone. Tier-I marks are used only for shortlisting to Tier-II. Tier-II Merit: Candidates must meet the applicable minimum qualifying marks separately in Part-I and Part-II. The combined Tier-II score is used for preparing the final merit list.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Post Preference and Department Allocation
content_sections.text: The notification provides a combined examination framework for each post code. Candidates who are shortlisted must submit their eligible department/post preferences when DSSSB opens the online e-dossier process. At least one department/post preference must be submitted. Preference submission takes place at the online e-dossier stage. Only departments for which the candidate meets all essential conditions should be selected. Preferences become final after confirmation. Candidates who fail to submit preferences within the notified period will not be considered for nomination/selection. Department allocation is based on merit, available vacancies, reservation and submitted preferences. No waiting panel will be maintained under the combined examination scheme. Important: Candidates cannot claim another department after being allocated their first available preference according to merit. The department preferences should therefore be selected carefully.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for DSSSB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants should keep relevant documents ready for registration, application submission and later e-dossier verification. Class 10 / Matriculation certificate and marksheet. Electrical Engineering degree or diploma, for applicable Junior Engineer positions. Relevant electrical installation, maintenance or professional experience certificates where required. ITI certificate, where applicable to the notified qualification route. Valid photo identity proof. SC/ST certificate, where applicable. OBC (Delhi) Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where applicable. EWS Income and Asset Certificate for the prescribed financial year. PwBD certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen service/discharge documents, where applicable. Meritorious Sportsperson certificate, where applicable. Documents supporting departmental or contractual-service age relaxation. Other certificates required by the concerned department and DSSSB.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Reservation and Eligibility Rules 2026
content_sections.text: Reservation is governed by the applicable Government of NCT of Delhi and Government of India instructions. Only candidates satisfying the notified OBC (Delhi) conditions are entitled to the applicable OBC reservation and age-relaxation benefits. OBC candidates from outside Delhi do not automatically qualify for those benefits. EWS applicants must possess the prescribed Income and Asset Certificate valid for financial year 2026-27 , issued on the basis of income for financial year 2025-26. PwBD candidates must check whether their specific disability category is identified as suitable for the department and post. Suitability is not identical across all Junior Engineer departments. Horizontal reservation figures are included in the published vacancy count and are not additional vacancies.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Admit Card and Examination Date
content_sections.text: The Board will publish examination schedules, admit card instructions and relevant recruitment updates through dsssb.delhi.gov.in . Candidates should follow the official examination instructions and carry the required admit card and identity document to the allotted examination centre.
